subject: OrchidBank CAIQ: scope confirmation, owner roster, and sample artifacts
messages:
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@orchidbank.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com
Cc: complianceops@orchidbank.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ intake: scope & evidence request for Redwood Inference

Hi Lauren,

Thanks for taking this on. OrchidBank is starting a vendor review for cloud controls and we'd like Redwood's CAIQ submission plus supporting artifacts. To keep the intake tight, can you confirm: 1) the in-scope product(s) / API endpoints (hosted/dedicated/private) you want us to evaluate; 2) model & dataset residency (regions) that apply; and 3) a single point of contact for evidence handoff?

We're primarily focused on controls related to data retention, key management, encryption in transit/rest, and change management. Our goal is to complete the CAIQ review in two weeks if owners can supply evidence. Can you also provide a short owner roster mapping to control families (or attach a preliminary mapping) and any sample artifacts (e.g., key rotation logs, retention policy, audit log extracts)?

Attachments: none on this message.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Jensen
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
OrchidBank

From: lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@orchidbank.com>
Cc: kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com, priyom.das@redwood-inference.com, marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 1 Jun 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: scope & evidence request for Redwood Inference

Hi Sarah — thanks for the note and timeline.

Quick answers up front:
- Scope: Redwood Hosted API (public endpoints) + Redwood Dedicated (reserved capacity) will be in scope. We can optionally include Redwood Private if you need on-prem attestation — confirm and we'll add.
- Regions: US (primary), EU (limited) — for this run please scope US-only artifacts unless you ask otherwise.
- POC: I'll be the primary contact for package coordination; Kim Park will be control owner lead and Priyom Das will drive evidence collation. Marcus Lin will handle telemetry/log extracts.

I've attached a first-pass workbook (redwood_caiq_draft_v0.1.xlsx) that maps CAIQ questions to likely owners and a one-line status column (draft). Can you confirm whether OrchidBank prefers control-level artifacts bundled per-control or a zipped evidence bundle organized by control family? That will help us format delivery.

Planned next steps (internal):
- By EOD tomorrow: Priyom to populate mapping with links to artifacts where available.
- Day 2-3: Kim to flag gaps and request additional artifacts from relevant teams.
- Day 4-10: Produce an evidence bundle and secure sample logs for review.

If that timeline looks tight, we can propose a phased delivery: initial control-level artifacts for high-risk controls (encryption, KMS, retention) day 4, full package by day 10.

Thanks — Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Customer Security Programs
Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_caiq_draft_v0.1.xlsx

From: priyom.das@redwood-inference.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com, kimberly.park@redwood-inference.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood-inference.com, Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@orchidbank.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Jun 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: CAIQ mapping workbook and owner roster (draft)

Hi team — attaching the mapping workbook we've started: caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx. Notes inline:
- Control owners added for each CAIQ question where we have a clear owner (IAM, Infra, Platform, Legal).
- Marked controls that need telemetry extracts (logs) and those requiring redactions before sharing.
- KMS evidence: we have rotation schedule exports and rotation event logs (Marcus to extract last 12 months).
- Retention: we have the Data Retention policy and a sample S3 lifecycle rule export.

Two asks for OrchidBank:
1) Please confirm if a masked sample of access logs is acceptable (we'll redact user identifiers) or whether you require full, unredacted logs under an NDA.
2) What level of attestation cover letter would you like attached to the CAIQ? (short summary from our CISO or a formal SOC-style attestation)

Attachments: caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx

On gaps: the change management trace for some infra component upgrades needs a deeper pull — Kim will coordinate with infra ops and expects to have artifacts by Friday.

Thanks — Priyom
Senior Security Analyst, Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@orchidbank.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood-inference.com, priyom.das@redwood-inference.com
Cc: complianceops@orchidbank.com
Date: Thu, 3 Jun 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: CAIQ intake: scope & evidence request for Redwood Inference

Lauren / Priyom — appreciate the rapid turn. A few clarifications:

- Masked logs are acceptable for the initial review. If we need full logs for a deeper check we'll request them under a specific NDA clause — for now please redact personally identifying fields.
- Attestation: a short cover letter from your CISO summarizing scope and data residency is preferred. Doc should be 1 page max.
- Delivery format: a zipped evidence bundle organized by control family is easiest. We'll accept a Google Drive folder with a single manifest + zipped artifacts.

Please go ahead on the phased delivery: high-risk controls first. Can you confirm a target date for the high-risk package (controls for encryption, KMS, retention, change mgmt) — today's timeline would set that for Mon 6/7, and full package by Thu 6/10. Please confirm whether those dates work.

Also sharing a Drive link for upload & a HubSpot intake id for our tracking: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcD_example_drive_link | HubSpot HS-4391.

Thanks — Sarah
Senior Vendor Risk Manager
OrchidBank
Attachments: none
